purpose: Validate signal price context without mutating P_MATRIX.

pinnacle.notes: Primary benchmark for no-vig price/CLV when market, timestamp and settlement rules match.

circa.notes: Secondary sharp sportsbook reference when physically available for the exact event/market.

betfair.notes: Use only normalized executable back/lay market evidence with liquidity/freshness controls; do not substitute last traded price blindly.

fanduel.notes: Large-market comparator; never treated as a sharp consensus vote.
